period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 30 September 2024. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. This period's PDF was already downloaded and pdftotext-extracted in a prior session, which found the embedded text corrupted (e.g. 'TotalAssets 427,036,857,317' vs the balance sheet's own bottom-line 'Total Liabilities & Shareholders' Equity 427,036,867,317' -- a 10,000 discrepancy the prior session could not resolve, plus stray characters like a section-symbol standing in for '5'). This session re-rendered the same PDF to images with pdftoppm and ran fresh tesseract OCR (bypassing the source PDF's own embedded, apparently-OCR-derived text layer entirely) and every single balance-sheet and P&L subtotal reconciled exactly (or within BDT 1-2, immaterial rounding) with zero corrections needed -- notably resolving the prior session's 427,036,857,317-vs-867,317 discrepancy in favour of ...867,317, confirmed independently via Total Liabilities + Total Equity = 398,671,817,932 + 28,365,049,385 = 427,036,867,317 exactly. Retained surplus for the 9 months (1,342,576,321) plus the Dec-23 Surplus-in-P&L (1,129,239,228) does not equal the Sep-24 Surplus-in-P&L (1,365,240,115); the ~1,106.6m gap matches almost exactly 10% of paid-up capital, the same FY2023 cash dividend effect documented in quarterly/2024_H1.json (not an error).
